**Current University Students Only ！**

This opportunity is intended to be undertaken as an **unpaid, university\-approved vocational or Work Integrated Learning (WIL) placement**, subject to approval by the student’s university.

It is designed for current engineering students who would like to gain supervised practical experience across solar, battery storage and smart energy projects while completing their university studies.

**Eligible Students**

Applicants must be currently studying:

* Electrical Engineering
* Renewable Energy Engineering
* Energy Engineering
* Power Systems
* Mechatronic Engineering
* A related engineering discipline

**About Us**

**Aussie Hybrid Solar** is the customer\-facing solar and battery installation service brand operated by **JT Solar Technology Pty Ltd**, a Sydney\-based renewable energy technology company established in 2009\.

JT Solar Technology has established a **Joint Battery Testing Laboratory with UNSW**, supporting applied research into battery performance, safety, reliability and compatibility.

We also participate in government\-supported clean energy initiatives, including projects delivered through the **Trailblazer for Recycling and Clean Energy (TRaCE) program**.

**What You May Work On**

During the placement, students may:

* Review solar and battery project documentation
* Review technical data sheets, product manuals and equipment specifications
* Assist with supervised analysis of solar generation, energy usage and battery performance data
* Support technical records, data summaries and draft reports
* Review testing, installation and commissioning documentation
* Research renewable energy technologies and technical questions
* Compare equipment specifications and system information
* Observe how engineering and project teams coordinate real renewable energy projects

All engineering\-related activities will be completed under appropriate supervision.

Students will **not undertake licensed electrical work, live electrical work or unsupervised high\-risk activities**.

**What You Will Gain**

* Practical exposure to **real solar, battery and smart energy projects**
* Experience with technical documentation and project processes
* Insight into renewable energy system design, testing and commissioning
* Exposure to equipment specifications and system performance data
* Development of technical research and problem\-solving skills
* Professional guidance and feedback from experienced team members

**Applicants must:**

* Be currently enrolled at an Australian university
* Have an interest in solar, battery storage and smart energy systems
* Be organised, responsible and willing to learn
* Be available to attend the placement in person

Experience with **AutoCAD, electrical design software, Microsoft Excel, data analysis, technical report writing or equipment data sheets** would be beneficial but is not essential.

**Placement Arrangement**

* **Location:** Sydney, NSW — In person
* **Duration:** Approximately 1–3 months, depending on university requirements
* The attendance schedule will be agreed based on approved placement requirements and student availability.

Any future paid casual or part\-time opportunities would be recruited separately and are **not guaranteed as part of this placement**.

**How to Apply**

Please send your **resume and a short introduction** to:

**info@aussiehybridsolar.com.au**

Please include:

* Your university, degree and current year of study
* Your required placement days or hours
* Your proposed placement dates and availability

**Company Description**  

At Ramsay Pharmacy, we are more than just Australia’s leading Community \& Hospital Pharmacy network. We are part of Ramsay Health care, proudly employing more than 90,000 of the best people who expertly look after millions of patients across 10 countries globally every year.

 **Job Description**  

The Ramsay Pharmacy Internship Program is designed to equip interns with the foundational knowledge, skills and confidence required to become capable and skilled pharmacists.

* Comprehensive support as you work towards achieving your supervised practice hours, helping you develop your pharmacy knowledge and practical skills.
* Access to weekly tutorials, workbooks, quizzes and exam preparation.
* Guidance and support from trained AHPRA examiners, clinical pharmacist educators, senior staff, preceptors and supervisors.
* Gain valuable insights into avoiding errors, implementing safety nets, reviewing high\-risk situations, and exploring ongoing professional development and career pathways.

**Your Role**

* Work alongside experienced pharmacists to accurately dispense medications, support medication management and provide medication information to patients.
* Collaborate with healthcare professionals to support seamless patient care and contribute to day\-to\-day pharmacy operations.
* Maintain compliance with regulations and ethical guidelines while prioritising patient safety and confidentiality.

**What We Offer**

* A leading\-edge program to support your transition from study to clinical practice, including professional development through the Ramsay Pharmacy Academy
* A hardcopy AMH to support your oral exam preparation, plus access to scholarships, training programs and external courses
* Participation in our Intern of the Year program, with the winner receiving AHPRA registration and SHPA/PSA membership paid for in 2027
* Opportunities to attend industry conferences and explore career pathways across hospital, community, operations and leadership
* Attractive remuneration, employee benefits and work flexibility to support work\-life balance

**St George Private Hospital**


Join the supportive team at **Ramsay Pharmacy St George**, located within St George Private Hospital in Kogarah, and gain hands\-on experience across both **hospital and community pharmacy**. With exposure to **Oncology, Cardiology, Orthopaedics, Maternity, Surgical and Medical services**, you’ll build a strong foundation for a rewarding clinical career. Our interns have gone on to become **clinical pharmacists on the wards and in Oncology**, offering exciting opportunities for future career development. You’ll also benefit from a supportive team, specialised services and convenient public transport access. Our two interns **alternate fortnightly between day shifts (8am–4pm) and evening shifts (3pm–11pm)**, giving you a well\-rounded experience from day one!

 **Qualifications** **About You**

We are seeking Interns who are passionate about delivering exceptional customer and patient care in line with Ramsay’s core values. Key attributes include:

* Strong communication skills and empathy
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment
* Confidence to make informed decisions and take ownership of your practice

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Full working rights in Australia or New Zealand
* Bachelor of Pharmacy or equivalent qualification (this must be completed before commencing internship)
* Be provisionally registered with AHPRA by early 2027\.


Available for a minimum of 12 months full\-time employment

* Apply now – applications close 13 September 2026, 11:55pm

**The Scots College BASC** is a privately\-owned, family\-operated company providing high\-quality Outside of School Hours (OOSH) care to families at ***The Scots College, Bellevue Hill***.

We are excited to be expanding our team and are currently seeking **two enthusiastic OOSH Assistants** committed to working from **2:00pm to 6:00pm at least 3 \- 4 days per week.** This opportunity reflects our continued commitment to delivering exceptional care and enriching experiences to more families.

Our programs are guided by the *My Time, Our Place* framework, offering school\-aged children engaging, play\-based, and leisure\-focused activities that celebrate their individuality, interests, and choices.

**About the Position:**

* Supervise and engage with children during play, ensuring their physical safety at all times
* Promote and guide positive behaviour in line with service policies and child\-safe practices
* Assist in the development and implementation of engaging programs that support children’s independence, social skills, learning, and overall development
* Foster an inclusive, supportive, and fun environment that reflects the interests and needs of the children

**Current Qualifications and Experience:**

* A valid Working With Children Check (WWCC)
* A genuine passion for working with children and supporting their wellbeing and development
* Ability to build positive, respectful relationships with children, families, and colleagues
* Previous experience in an OOSH or similar child\-focused environment (preferred but not essential)

**Availability:**

* **School Term:** Monday to Friday, 2:00pm – 6:00pm ( or Monday to Thursday availability per week)
* **School Holidays (Vacation Care):** Monday to Friday between 8:00am – 5:30pm (flexible shifts within these hours)
* This is a **permanent part\-time position**

Job Type: Part\-time

Experience:

* OOSH: 1 year (Preferred)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

**Company Introduction**

Bring It on Sports is a sports marketing and recreational service dedicated to providing a high standard of instructors, coaches, referees, umpires and support staff for sports, dance, fitness and self\-defense activities for all ages and abilities.

We are looking for friendly, dedicated and passionate people who are motivated to enrich people's lives through sports and movement in 2025 and beyond. This is a great opportunity for people pursuing a career in the Sports, Dance, Fitness or Wellness Industry. Some of the many additional programs we run are Special Olympics, Goalball, and Flag Football Sporting Schools.

This Job will enable university students and sports fans completing a relevant degree in PDHPE teaching, Sports Coaching/Science or Human Movement to get experience whilst studying with flexible hours with future permanent opportunities for the right candidates.

**We provide for:**

Pre\-schools, primary schools, secondary schools, special needs schools, community centres, OOSH centres, vacation care centres, school holiday clinics, birthday parties, clubs, and adult/corporate fitness.

Sports Coach\- Casual

* Day \& Time: Must be available to work during school hours
* Date Commencing: September 2026
* Location: Sydney wide
* Pay is dependent on Qualifications and experience

* High energy coach that can engage and motivate teenage students.
* Plan creative sessions and be able to adjust to the needs of the group.

 **About Us**

Rosebank College has a proud and varied history of over 150 years as part of the Good Samaritan family established in 1857, and belonging to the Benedictine spiritual and educational tradition founded by St Benedict in the 4th century. The College belongs to the community of ten schools across Australia called Good Samaritan Education (GSE). Established in 2011 by the Sisters of the Good Samaritan, the mission of Good Samaritan Education is to sustain and nurture our Catholic schools as Good Samaritan Benedictine communities of learning.


Catholic education in the Good Samaritan Benedictine tradition is committed to developing students who will engage with today’s world as grounded, hope\-filled young people who are equipped to lead wisely, to listen deeply and to treat their neighbour and their environment with justice, love and the compassion of Christ.


Rosebank College promotes an inclusive, welcoming environment for children and provides transparent, accountable, risk\-managed approaches to ensure child safeguarding.


As a school of Good Samaritan Education, Rosebank College is incorporated and governed by a Board of Directors which is accountable through the Company Members to Good Samaritan Education.


For further information about Rosebank College, please visit our website: www.rosebank.nsw.edu.au.

Rosebank College invites applications for the position of History / Religious Education Teacherto join our highly collaborative teaching community in apermanent full\-time (1\.0 FTE) position commencing in Term 1, 2027**.**


The successful applicant will teach History and Religious Education across a range of year levels and collaborate with the History and Religious Education faculties.


We are seeking an engaging, knowledgeable and highly effective educator with the ability to teach History and Religious Education across Stages 4 and 5**.** Experience and capacity to teachStage 6 Historywould be highly regarded.


The successful applicant will contribute to curriculum development, student achievement, faith formation and the broader life of the College, working collaboratively with colleagues to provide engaging, rigorous and contemporary learning experiences.


Our faculties foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration and evidence\-informed teaching practice. Rosebank College provides strong professional learning and mentoring opportunities to support teachers throughout their professional journey.


All teaching staff are expected to contribute to the pastoral care of students, demonstrate a commitment to the ideals and ethos of Catholic education, and participate in the co\-curricular and community life of the College.


Applicants must be excellent classroom practitioners, committed to the care and wellbeing of students, collaborative team members and confident in integrating contemporary pedagogical practices and educational technologies into their teaching.


For further information about the role, please refer to the Position Description available through the online application form.

The successful applicant will be an outstanding educator who is highly motivated to support Rosebank College’s continued academic achievement and faith formation by inspiring and developing innovative learning that engages and values every learner.


All staff are expected to support the College’s vision and goals as a learning community and contribute positively to all aspects of College life.


To be considered for this position, applicants must demonstrate:

* Experience as an effective, innovative and engaging teacher of History and Religious Education
* Ability to teach History across Stages 4 and 5
* Ability to teach Religious Education across Stages 4 and 5
* Capacity and/or experience teaching Stage 6 History, which would be highly regarded
* Capacity to contribute to the delivery of Stage 6 Religious Education courses, which would be highly regarded
* Sound knowledge and understanding of current NESA syllabuses and curriculum requirements
* Ability to work effectively and collaboratively across the History and Religious Education faculties
* Commitment to contemporary, evidence\-informed teaching practices that promote academic excellence
* Ability to use student data effectively to differentiate curriculum and address the learning needs of all students
* Commitment to the Australian Professional Standards for Teachers
* Demonstrated ability to integrate technology effectively into teaching, learning and planning
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills when working with students, parents and colleagues
* Current NESA Accreditation and approval to teach in NSW
* A current Working with Children Check
* Commitment to child safeguarding principles and practices
* Willingness to actively support the Catholic ethos and Good Samaritan Benedictine tradition of the College
* Commitment to supporting the College’s Pastoral Care Program, including Home Room responsibilities
* Willingness to contribute to the broader co\-curricular and community life of the College

If you meet the requirements of this position, please click on theApply Now button to submit your online application to the Principal of Rosebank College.


When you complete theonline application, you will need to provide:

* A copy of your CV;
* A cover letter;
* Upload copies of formal teaching qualifications, including copies of transcripts;
* Provide details of your Current NESA Accreditation and approval to teach in NSW.

  

Candidates who progress through our recruitment process will be required to provide at least two (2\) referees, including their current employer.


Early applications are encouraged to assist the interview process. Please note that applications will be considered as they are received, and an appointment may be made prior to the application closing date.


The appointment of a successful candidate is conditional and based on the successful completion of all pre\-employment screening for child\-related employment and reference checks.

Rosebank College has zero tolerance for child abuse. We are committed to providing a safe, supportive, and respectful environment for all students. Child safety and wellbeing are embedded in our practices.

**Administration:** 10 hours per week  

**Leadership Structure:** Program Manager \+ 2 x Directors of Service \+ 2 x 2ICs.

As Program Manager, you will work closely with the onsite leadership team to oversee the day\-to\-day success of the service across Before School Care, After School Care and Vacation Care.  

  

This is a hands\-on leadership role. You won't be leading from behind a desk. You'll be visible on the floor, working alongside your team, providing coaching and support and ensuring the service operates to a high standard.

* Lead the day\-to\-day operations of a large, high\-volume OSHC service
* Oversee operations across both the Juniors and Seniors sites
* Work closely with the Directors of Service and 2ICs to provide strong and consistent leadership
* Lead, coach, mentor and develop permanent and casual educators
* Support your team during contact hours and lead by example
* Manage staffing, ratios, compliance, programming and operational requirements
* Build strong relationships with children, families, school leaders and the wider school community
* Oversee communication with families and the school
* Establish strong routines, systems and processes across the service
* Drive high\-quality, engaging and inclusive programming
* Identify issues early and take ownership of finding solutions
* Maintain high standards of safety, compliance and quality
* Ensure administration is completed accurately and within required timeframes
* Build a positive, accountable and high\-performing team culture
* Support the continued growth and development of the service

* Strong OSHC leadership experience, highly desirable
* Experience managing a split\-site service or multiple operating environments, essential
* Experience leading permanent and casual teams
* Strong operational and organisational skills
* The ability to manage competing priorities and changing needs
* Confidence leading, directing, coaching and holding a team accountable
* Strong communication and relationship\-building skills
* Excellent administration and attention to detail
* Strong follow\-through and the ability to close the loop
* A proactive and solutions\-focused approach
* Confidence managing staffing, ratios, compliance and programming

* Speech and language assessment and intervention
* Social communication
* Functional communication
* AAC
* Mealtime management and swallowing
* Goal setting and intervention planning
* Working with children, adults and families
* NDIS documentation and report writing
* Clinical risk and safe practice
* Working collaboratively within an MDT

**What You'll Be Doing**  

You'll deliver evidence\-informed, person\-centred Speech Pathology services across community, clinic, home, school and telehealth environments.  

  

Your caseload will build gradually as your skills and confidence develop, with ongoing clinical support available throughout your graduate year.

**What You'll Bring**  

* Degree in Speech Pathology completed or nearing completion
* Speech Pathology Australia membership or eligibility
* Interest in community, disability and person\-centred practice
* Curiosity, initiative and willingness to learn
* Strong communication and organisational skills
* Driver's licence and access to a reliable vehicle
* NDIS Worker Screening Check and Working With Children Check, or willingness to obtain them

**Your Speech Pathology Career Starts Here**  

We're not looking for graduates who already have all the answers. We're looking for people who want to learn, ask questions and become great clinicians.  

  

If you want your first year to give you genuine clinical experience while still having structure and support around you, we'd love to hear from you.
